questions.question:
A: What ______ you be in the future?
B: I will be a doctor. I want to help people.
questions.explanation: 詢問「未來將會」成為什麼，使用未來式助動詞 will。
questions.commonMisconception: 慣性選 do，未注意到未來情境時間點。

questions.question: My brother loves planes. He will be a ______ one day.
questions.explanation: 喜歡飛機的人，夢想職業通常是飛行員 (pilot)。
questions.commonMisconception: 不認識職業詞彙。

questions.question: If you like to help sick animals, you will be a ______.
questions.explanation: 幫助「動物」的醫生是獸醫 (vet)。
questions.commonMisconception: 分不清 doctor 與 vet 的服務對象。

questions.question:
A: Will Toby ______ a scientist when he grows up?
B: Yes, he will. He loves science.
questions.explanation: 助動詞 will 之後接「原形動詞」。B 動詞的原形為 be。
questions.commonMisconception: 學生習慣用 am/is/are，不熟悉 be 原形用法。

questions.question: I ______ have a big pizza for lunch tomorrow. It's my birthday!
questions.explanation: 時間副詞 tomorrow 提示未來式，選用 will。
questions.commonMisconception: 時態與時間副詞未對應。

questions.question:
A: Will they go to Taipei next week?
B: No, they ______. They will go to Tainan.
questions.explanation: 對 Will 開頭疑問句的否定簡答為 No, they won't (will not)。
questions.commonMisconception: 受習慣用語影響選 don't 或 aren't。

questions.question: We ______ work hard to be famous singers.
questions.explanation: 助動詞 will 加原形動詞 work。若選 will be 則後方應接 V-ing 或名詞/形容詞。
questions.commonMisconception: 混淆 will 與 will be 的後面結構。

questions.question: Sam ______ a teacher in ten years. He likes kids.
questions.explanation: in ten years (十年後) 表示未來。成為某種職業需要 B 動詞 be，故選 will be。
questions.commonMisconception: 漏掉 B 動詞，只選 will。

questions.question: ______ you ______ help me with my homework tomorrow?
questions.explanation: 未來式疑問句結構：Will + 主詞 + 原形動詞。
questions.commonMisconception: 結構成分誤用（如 will 配 V-ing）。

questions.question:
Lily wants to be a nurse. Ken wants to be a doctor. They both want to help people in the hospital.
Question: Where will Lily and Ken work in the future?
questions.explanation: 護理師和醫生工作的場域通常是在醫院 (hospital)。
questions.commonMisconception: 職業與場所對應發生錯誤。

questions.question:
It's cold now. I will buy a jacket. It will be hot tomorrow. I will go swimming.
Question: What will I do tomorrow?
questions.explanation: 文中敘述明天的計畫是 go swimming。
questions.commonMisconception: 受第一句 'I will buy a jacket' 影響而忽略時間點對應。

questions.question:
In 2050, robots will do everything for us. They will cook and speak ten languages.
Question: Will robots speak English in 2050?
questions.explanation: 機器人會說十種語言 (ten languages)，英語作為主要語言必定包含在內。肯定回答用 Yes, they will。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法進行「十種語言」與「英語」的包含邏輯推理。

questions.question:
I like to draw pictures. I don't like to sing. I will be an artist.
Question: Does the writer like music?
questions.explanation: 作者說不喜歡唱歌 (don't like to sing)，暗示不喜歡音樂（或唱歌相關活動）。問句用 Does，回答用 doesn't。
questions.commonMisconception: 對問句助動詞與事實推論的雙重判讀錯誤。

questions.question:
Dr. Wang is a vet. She helps a cat today. She will help a dog tomorrow.
Question: Who is Dr. Wang?
questions.explanation: vet (獸醫) 的同義解釋即為安 animal doctor。
questions.commonMisconception: 不認識 vet 或無法進行同義代換。

questions.question: Everyone in our class ______ going to be successful in the future.
questions.explanation: Everyone 在文法上視為單數，B 動詞用 is。
questions.commonMisconception: 受 class 或眾多學生的集體感影響誤選 are。

questions.question: Tom likes to help sick people. He should join the ______ Club.
questions.explanation: 喜歡助人（病人），最相關的是醫療 (Medical) 社團。
questions.commonMisconception: 詞義聯想力不足。

questions.question: I want to buy a new computer next year. I ______ save (存) my money now.
questions.explanation: 為了明年的購買計畫，現在「將要/將會」開始存錢。表達未來意向。
questions.commonMisconception: 對時態的因果連結掌握不夠。

questions.question: If you want to be a great ______, you should practice singing every day.
questions.explanation: 每天練習唱歌，是為了成為歌手 (singer)。
questions.commonMisconception: 邏輯對應錯誤。

questions.question: A ______ often travels to different countries by plane.
questions.explanation: 搭飛機到不同國家的職業最符合的是飛行員 (pilot)。
questions.commonMisconception: 不具備職業行為之綜合認知。

questions.question:
Let's meet again in 2030! We ______ all be big boys and girls then.
Question: Choose the best words.
questions.explanation: 2030 年是未來，助動詞用 will。
questions.commonMisconception: 遺漏未來時間標記。
